Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! KL Rahul and Shikhar Dhawan are sitting near the ropes. The fielders are warming up on the field. Out come the openers and the fielders. Lungi Ngidi is going to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! 288 is what India need to end the series with a win. The pitch is quite good to bat on and they would back themselves to chase it. But they need a couple of big stands and that has been a concern for them in the series. Will India chase it down or will South Africa's attack make lives difficult for the batters yet again? Stay with us to find out.

India had a good comeback with the ball. They took early wickets with Deepak Chahar striking at the start and there was also a run out. The spinners then troubled the South African batters a bit but didn't break the big stand in the middle overs. It was looking like they would have to chase a big total but they got back in the game by picking up regular wickets. Bumrah came back and got rid of de Kock and Chahal got the wicket of van der Dussen soon. They kept the intensity up after that and never let the South African middle order cut loose like they would have wanted to. Bumrah was the pick of the bowlers for his two wickets and Krishna too bowled well in the death overs while the rest of the bowlers had a decent game too.

For South Africa it was all about one partnership. They lost their top order quite early and were in some trouble at 70 for 3. Rassie van der Dussen and Quinton de Kock then stitched a lovely stand to get their side back on top. The pair added 144 runs for the fourth wicket with de Kock getting a brilliant ton and van der Dussen going past the half-century mark as well. They were well set and South Africa were 170 for 3 at the 30-over mark. They would have wanted to get a big score post that but losing both their set batters in consecutive overs cost them a lot. They lost a bunch of wickets after that and their charge was halted. David Miller did stitch a good stand with Dwaine Pretorius though to get them close to the 300-run mark but South Africa would be disappointed with their finish.

At the 30-over mark, South Africa would have been expecting a score beyond 320 probably. But India have done well after that to restrict them to a much lower score than that. Still, this remains a good score but nowhere close to what the hosts should have gotten.

OUT! TAKEN! That's that and South Africa have been bowled out for 287! Prasidh Krishna goes for the slower one yet again and pitches this one right up, on off stump. Sisanda Magala makes room and looks to smash it over extra cover. Mangala gets no timing whatsoever on it and hits it straight towards KL Rahul at extra cover. The skipper takes a comfortable catch and that will be the end of the South African innings. Prasidh Krishna ends with 3 wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c KL Rahul b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker, around off and Nigidi can do nothing about it.
Lungi Ngidi is the last batter.

OUT! TAKEN! This is smart bowling from Prasidh Krishna and he picks up his second wicket. This is pushed well wide and is slower in pace. At this stage, Miller just has to go for the big shot and he looks to lift this one over the cover region. The ball comes off of the toe end of the bat and flies towards wide long off. Virat Kohli settles under it and takes a calm catch, right on the ropes. India have pulled things back well in the final overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter in length, at the body. Miller looks to pull but takes his eyes off the ball. The ball goes off his arm and towards point.
FOUR! Full and very wide, slower too. David Miller throws his hands at it and manages to slice it over backward point for a boundary.
Full and straight, flicked through mid-wicket for one. Miller will have the strike for the last over.
Sisanda Magala is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Jasprit Bumrah is just too good at the death and we can see why. Bumrah goes full and wide but takes the pace off the ball. The ball is taken away from Keshav Maharaj's hitting arc and he is forced to fetch it. And fetch it he does. Maharaj drags this one and lifts it straight back over the bowler's head. Virat Kohli moves to his left from long on and takes an assured catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant bowling! Miller tries to unsettle Bumrah as he moves inside the crease. Bumrah though fires in a yorker at the toes, at 141 kph. Miller just about jams it out on the leg side and picks up a single.
Slower one, pushed wider. Maharaj drags it from outside off and heaves it towards wide long on for a single.
Swing and a miss! Full and wide, it was in the slot a bit. Maharaj moves leg side and throws his hands at it but isn't able to make a connection.
Bumrah bowls ths cutter, on middle. Miller adjusts well to the extra bounce and guides it towards short third man. They take one.
Miller wants two but Maharaj says no. Slower one, angled at the pads. Miller bunts it into the vacant square leg region for a single. He will keep strike for the next over.
Full and wide, Maharaj steps out and creams it through cover but will get just one for it.

FOUR! Not sure what Keshav Maharaj was looking to go that fine but it has brought him a boundary. Good-length ball, outside off and there's pace behind this one. Maharaj just waits for it and the last moment opens the face off the bat. The ball races away into the third man fence.
Krishna sees Miller advancing and bowls it short, at the body. Miller manages to pull it towards deep square leg and collects a run.
Keshav Maharaj is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! The change of pace has worked for Prasidh Krishna. Slower one, fuller in length and on the stumps. Dwaine Pretorius doesn't pick it up and looks to heave it on the leg side. He is way too early in his shot and ends up just lifting it towards deep mid-wicket. Suryakumar Yadav takes an easy catch over there but Pretorius will feel he has done his job.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Krishna hurls across a full toss, on the body. Miller gets cramped for room and only manages to work it away towards deep square leg. They get a single.
Length again, on off. Miller edges it down towards the third man region for a single. With just 3 overs remaining, can Miller power his side to a score beyond 300?
Back of a length, outside off. Pretorius taps it towards cover for one.
Pretorius had no idea about that one though. Another slower one, into the pitch and outside off. Pretorius hops and looks to pull but the ball goes well beneath his bat.
FOUR! Crunched! Slower one, on a length and bowled wider. Dwaine Pretorius stands back and just slaps it through extra cover for a boundary.
That could have been catastrophic! Full and straight, Pretorius bunts it out towards short mid on. Miller is backing up well outside the crease but manages to get back.
Banged in short, around off. Miller plays a controlled pull shot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another good short ball, over leg stump. Pretorius looks to pull but misses.
A dipping full toss, outside off. Miller is unable to take advantage as he slaps it towards sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! This is angled onto the pads and David Miller whips it powerfully into the backward square leg fence.
Around the top of middle, Pretorius works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A well-directed short ball, over middle. Pretorius is well beaten.
A length ball, on the pads. Miller flicks it away to deep backward square leg for one.
Length, on off. Pushed to mid off for one.

Jasprit Bumrah really seems confident and KL Rahul has taken the review for a caught behind decision. The ball seems close to the bat and the glove. UltraEdge shows that there's a flat line as the ball goes past the bat. The LBW will now be checked as well. Ball Tracker shows that the ball is going well over leg stump. NOT OUT.

NOT OUT! Length ball, around off. This comes back in sharply. Miller is cut in half and the ball goes to the right of Pant. He dives and gathers it. There is a big appeal from Jasprit Bumrah but the umpire is unmoved. KL Rahul takes the review this time. UltraEdge shows that there was no bat on it and the ball brushed the pads on its way to the keeper. They check for the LBW but Ball Tracker shows the ball going over the stumps.
Back of a length, on off. Dwaine Pretorius ramps it to third man. It goes in the air but lands short of the fielder. Single taken.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out by Dwaine Pretorius.
On a length, outside off. A single down to third man for Miller.
Short of a length, slower and on the body. Pulled to fine leg for one.
Jasprit Bumrah (7-0-37-1) replaces Yuzvendra Chahal.
Length ball, around off. Dwaine Pretorius runs it to third man for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to short cover.

FOUR! Brilliant timing! A wide yorker by Prasidh Krishna and Dwaine Pretorius digs it out brilliantly. It beats the man at point. Deepak Chahar gets around from third man but cannot get there. 250 up!
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Banged in short, on middle. It goes way over the batter's head and is called a wide.
Back of a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius misses the drive.
Full and on the pads. Flicked to deep square leg for one.
Prasidh Krishna (6-0-33-0) comes back into the attack.

Loopy ball, lands outside off and comes back in. Dwaine Pretorius gets forward to block but gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for LBW but turned down. Rahul decides not to review it too. Maybe, there was some bat on it. Yup, UltraEdge confirms that there was an inside edge there.
FOUR! Dwaine Pretorius gets one away now! Flatter, on middle. He heaves it to the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter, around off. Miller works it to short third man. Dwaine Pretorius wants the single and sets off. They get one in the end.
SIX! In the arc and out of the park! Miller gets low to this ball outside off and then slog-sweeps it way over the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter, on off. Dwaine Pretorius goes back and works it to deep cover for one.
Dot ball! Tossed up, on middle. Miller blocks it off the front foot. Just 5 from the over.
Another dot as Miller works it to short cover.
Shorter, around off. Pushed to point.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Thrashed away! Iyer drops it short and wide outside off. Miller rocks back and cuts it to the cover fence.
A single as this is pushed to long on.
Shreyas Iyer (2-0-16-0) is back on.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Swept to fine leg for one. Just a single from that over!
Fuller, around off. Dwaine Pretorius looks to push it away but gets the inside edge to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Worked to cover.
Googly! Tossed up, lands outside off and turns in. Dwaine Pretorius misses his drive.
Loopy ball, on off. Worked to mid on.
Dwaine Pretorius is in at number 8.

OUT! RUN OUT! India get another one and Andile Phehlukwayo has to walk back! Flatter, on the body. Miller turns it towards mid-wicket. Andile Phehlukwayo is a bit hesitant at first but goes for the single. Shreyas Iyer though is not late in getting to the ball. He pounces on it and throws it to Rishabh Pant, who whips the bails off. Andile Phehlukwayo puts in a dive and the TV umpire is called but he feels that he is out. Yup, the replay confirms that despite the dive, Andile Phehlukwayo is well short.

Is that a run out? Phehlukwayo sure looks concerned. The umpires have taken it upstairs and the replay shows that Phehlukwayo was a few inches short when Pant whipped off the bails. The decision on the big screen is OUT and India right on top of proceedings here.
Time now for Powerplay 3. We are in the last 10 overs of the innings and 5 fielders can stay outside the ring.
Quicker delivery, on middle. Phehlukwayo presents a dead bat at it.
On middle. Blocked.
This is drifted into leg stump. Miller looks to work it away leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover. They take a single.
Full, on off. Phehlukwayo pushes it down to long off for a single.
Around middle and leg, pushed to the left of the bowler. Yadav dives and makes a good stop.
There is still a slip in place. If India can get another wicket here, they will have a firm grip on the game.

Peach! Phehlukwayo has no idea what happened here! On a length, drifted into middle. The ball just grips and turns away sharply. There is a bit of extra bounce as well. Phehlukwayo is well beaten and Yadav thinks there's an edge on it. 'Pocket, pocket', says Pant indicating that the ball flicked the pocket of the batter. Good decision from India to not review it.
Drifted onto the pads, Phehlukwayo clips it past leg slip and picks up a single.
Chahal switches to over the wicket. He tosses it up on middle and Phehlukwayo keeps it out on the leg side.
Well outside off, Miller fetches it and sweeps it towards deep square leg for another one.
Full again, outside off. Phehlukwayo works it through cover-point for one.
Chahal comes from 'round the wicket and tosses it full and wide. Phehlukwayo drives it towards cover.
Around leg and spinning in. Miller tucks it behind square for a single.
Shorter, on off. Miller rocks back and eases it through cover-point for one. It is important for the hosts that Miller bats as long as possible.
Tossed up, around off. Andile Phehlukwayo pushes it through covers for a run.
Beaten! Flatter, around off and just turns away ever so slightly, zipping past the outside edge.
On off, stroked through cover for one.
Flatter this time, angled into middle and leg. Miller manages to keep it out off the back foot.
Drifted into middle. Miller blocks it out.
Full, on middle. Miller flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Andile Phehlukwayo makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch! South Africa lose both their set batters and India have a real opportunity now to get things tightened up. Tossed up, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen takes on the slog sweep and hits it square, towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes flat and there's not much timing on it. Shreyas Iyer races in from the fence and dives down to his right to take a peach of a catch. Yuzvendra Chahal does get the wicket and he is elated.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around off and driven towards cover.

NOT OUT! Geez, that was so, so close! Yuzvendra Chahal bowls a gem of a leg spinner this time. He tosses it outside off, looking to take it away from Miller but the ball dips and turns back a long way. David Miller looks to defend off the front foot but gets pinged on the pads. The visitors seem convinced and it is reviewed. No bat was involved and Ball Tracker shows that the ball was just about clipping the top of leg stump. Miller survives on umpire's call and they get a leg bye.
Review time! Height was a matter of discussion but Virat Kohli thinks that it doesn't too high. No bat on that but wickets hitting has umpire's call after getting hit in line.
Nicely flighted, full again and on off. Miller flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Van der Dussen heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal (5-0-28-0) is back on.
Short again, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it firmly along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked away to fine leg for one. Miller is up and running.
David Miller is the new batter. The stage is set for him to flex his muscles.

OUT! TAKEN! Jasprit Bumrah is brought back into the attack and he does strike right away! This could make a huge difference in the final total. Banged in short by Bumrah, around middle. It is there to hit and Quinton de Kock hangs back and looks to smoke it over the mid-wicket fence. It is a tired pull shot from him and he doesn't get enough on it. The ball goes flat and straight down the throat of Shikhar Dhawan on the mid-wicket fence, who makes no mistake. Brilliant innings from de Kock and he gets a pat on the back from Bumrah as well.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Around the top of off. Blocked out.
Length again, angled across the off stump. Quinton de Kock makes a bit of room and caresses it through the cover region for a couple.
Ouch, that must have been painful! On a good length but slower in pace and around leg. De Kock looks to work it away leg side but misses and gets hit in the box.
Jasprit Bumrah (6-0-33-0) comes in to replace Jayant Yadav as India continue to search for the breakthrough.
Shorter ball, on off. Pushed to cover. 15 came from that over!
Length ball, slower too, on off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it out well.
Short, on the body. Pulled to deep square leg for just a single.
Just two! Full and on the pads. Flicked past deep mid-wicket for a couple by Quinton de Kock.
Free Hit continues! Too short and way outside off. Wide called as Quinton de Kock leaves it.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Short and on the body. De Kock swivels and pulls it hard to the square leg fence. To make things worse for India, next ball will be a Free Hit as Deepak Chahar has overstepped!
FOUR! Pre-meditated and well executed! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. De Kock shuffles across and then slaps it down to the fine leg fence. 200 up for South Africa.
Short and outside off. De Kock leaves it. Wide called.

50 for Rassie van der Dussen! He has been in sensational form in the series against India! He would look to get a big one too given that there is plenty of time left. Shoter, on the body. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
Deepak Chahar (7-0-38-0) is back into the attack.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. De Kock goes for the switch it but misses. It hits the pads and drops near him after looping up.
Shorter, around off. Punched to cover.
Rassie van der Dussen brings out the reverse sweep to deep cover for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
DROPPED! Loopy ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to reverse sweep. It comes off the gloves but Pant drops it again! Another drop for him today.
Shorter, on the body. Pulled to deep square leg for one. 1000 runs for Quinton de Kock against India in ODIs now at an average of almost 67!
Just a single as this is pushed past cover. 12 from the over.
Tossed up, wide outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to carve it over covers but gets it off the outer half. It goes over cover but is cut off by the man at sweeper cover. Two taken.
Flatter, around off. Punched to deep cover for one.
SIX! That is out of here! Rassie van der Dussen makes up his mind and dances down the track. He converts it in a full toss and heaves it over the long on fence. All the way.
Flatter and outside off. Quinton de Kock slaps it wide of long off. Rassie van der Dussen wants the second but de Kock is not interested.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it past square leg for one.
Shorter, on off. De Kock gets the inside edge on the pads.
Flatter, around off. Quinton de Kock is beaten as he looks to block.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Up and over! Loopy ball, on off. De Kock lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
FIVE WIDES! Free runs for South Africa! Tossed up down the leg side. De Kock misses the sweep and the ball runs to the fine leg fence.
Beaten! Flatter, just outside off. De Kock looks to block it but it goes past the outside edge.
Full, on off. Pushed to covers.
Jayant Yadav (6-0-37-0) is back on.
Shorter, on off. Blocked out.
A single as this is pushed past cover.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.

THERE IT IS! Quinton de Kock gets to his ton! His 6th ODI ton against India and he loves playing against them! Fuller, around off. Pushed past the diving cover fielder for a couple and Quinton de Kock soaks in the applause.
Full, on off. Blocked out.
Full, on off. Worked to mid on for one.

Drinks! South Africa are 170 for 2 at the 30-over mark and these two are looking in fine form. They would look to score in excess of 320 at the very least from here. India need a bunch of quick wickets to stop that from happening. Also, Shreyas Iyer to roll his arm now.
The wait just goes on for Quinton de Kock. A touch quicker, around leg and turning in. De Kock fails to get it away on the leg side and gets hit on the pads.
Short again, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it away with the spin and gets it through cover. They get a single and that brings up the 100-run partnership between these two.
Shorter in length, around off and this is punched off the back foot on the off side.

LEG BYE! Nicely bowled by Chahal. A lot more air on it and this is bowled on leg stump. The ball spins in and goes off the pads towards fine leg. They get a leg bye. A bunch of people in the crowd stand up to applaud de Kock but are left disappointed when the umpire gives it as leg byes.
Quicker one, on off. Van der Dussen flicks it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Very full, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clears the front leg and heaves it all along the ground and into the cow corner fence. Top shot!
Three dots on the trot and the wait continues for de Kock. Fullish ball, on off and de Kock mistimes the drive towards mid off. He remains on 99.
Length again, outside off and this is tapped straight towards cover-point.
A length ball, around off and angling across. De Kock just tries to run it down to third man but gets beaten.
SIX! Muscled! Back of a length, wide of off. Quinton de Kock stands tall and pulls it right back over the bowler's head for a biggie. He moves to 99 now.
NO BALL! Full and wide, van der Dussen slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single. Krishna has overstepped and a no ball is called. Free Hit time!
On a good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it towards cover.
Back of a length, on leg. De Kock pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up, outside off and turning away. Left alone.
Shorter in length, around leg. De Kock works it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Just inside! Very slow through the air this time and it is tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock has all the time in the world to get low and slog it to the backward square leg fence. He knowingly hit it behind square and this shows he knows exactly where the fielders are. He moves into the 90s now.
On middle and turning in. This is nudged away on the leg side.
FOUR! Top shot from Quinton de Kock! Tossed up, around off and de Kock reverse-sweeps it firmly between backward point and short third man for a boundary. He will likely look to get a move on now.
On off and turning away. Rassie van der Dussen waits for it and plays it through cover-point for a run.
Good-length ball, on off. De Kock dabs it down on the off side and looks for the quick single but is sent back by his partner.
Back of a length, angled across off. De Kock hops and taps it towards backward point.
Uppish but in the gap! Width on offer this time and van der Dussen carves it behind point for a single.
A length ball, around off and good natural bounce on offer for Krishna here. Rassie van der Dussen hangs deep and keeps it out on the off side.
On a good length, over middle. De Kock stands tall and works it through square leg for a single.
A short ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen goes fetching and pulls it firmly towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Change in bowling as Prasidh Krishna (4-0-21-0) comes back. He replaces Jayant Yadav.
Slower through the air and shorter in length, on off. De Kock hangs back and taps it back onto the deck.
On off, de Kock can't get it past the bowler.
Drifted into middle and turning away. Rassie van der Dussen watchfully plays it down to long off for yet another single.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock goes for the slog sweep but ends up dragging it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around leg. De Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
Slowed up, on middle. De Kock blocks it out.
Tossed up, around off and de Kock eases it down to long off for a single.
Yadav pulls back the length and bowls it on off. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Sliding onto the pads and this is flicked through square leg for one more.
Floated up, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it towards mid off and picks up a quick single.
A flighted delivery, around off and this is pushed towards cover.
Shorter in length, around off. Quinton de Kock cuts it off the back foot through point for one.
FOUR! Here comes the googly and Rassie van der Dussen has picked it well. Looped up, on middle and van der Dussen wrists it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Ripper! Beautifully drifted into off and then the ball just lands and turns away sharply. Rassie van der Dussen is drawn forward and plays the wrong line as the ball zips past the outside edge.
On middle. This is kept out on the leg side.
Nicely bolwed! This one is slower through the air and bowled outside off. Rassie van der Dussen is drawn forward but does well to edge it down with soft hands as the ball goes past the first slip.
A touch shorter and slower, on middle. The ball turns in and de Kock works it with the turn towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around off and turning in. De Kock strides out to defend.
Fuller this time, on middle and leg. De Kock drills it down towards long on for a single.
On off. Blocked out.
Sliding in from around off. Rassie van der Dussen lunges forward to block but the ball goes off the inside edge through square leg for one.
FOUR! Onto it in a flash! Just a tad bit short, around off. Rassie van der Dussen rocks back and cuts it powerfully into the cover-point fence.
Angled in on the pads, de Kock pushes it through mid on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock makes room on the leg side and strokes it through extra cover for a couple.
A little bit quicker and flatter, on middle. Quinton de Kock bunts it out on the off side for a quick single. The fifty partnership comes up between these two.
This is drifted in at the pads. Rassie van der Dussen gets his front leg out of the way and works it towards deep square leg for one.
Nicely flighted, around middle. De Kock just knocks it back past the bowler for a single.
A loopy ball on leg. De Kock pushes it towards mid on.
Nicely tossed up, around leg and dropping on the batter. De Kock nudges it out on the leg side.
Chahal gives it air and tosses it up on middle. De Kock caresses it through extra cover for a couple.
Yuzvendra Chahal is brought into the attack now.
Flatter delivery, around off and this is punched towards the cover region.
This is angled into the pads. De Kock works it on the leg side for one.
FOUR! He's toying with the field now! This is pushed through fuller, on middle. Quinton de Kock gets in position early and reverse-sweeps it behind point for a boundary.
A touch shorter, around off. De Kock taps it back onto the deck.
SIX! A lovely stroke! Tossed up, around middle. Quinton de Kock dances down the track and lifts it right back over the bowler's head for a clean maximum.

A huge chance missed! Flighted, on a length and outside off. Rassie just strokes it towards cover and sets off for the single. Suryakumar Yadav with a howler of a throw towards the keeper and de Kock is able to make it through. De Kock doesn't seem one bit happy with his partner though. A better throw and he could have been run out.
Length, on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
Almost chopped on! Length ball, outside off. De Kock goes for the drive but gets the inside edge past the stumps. It goes towards fine leg but the fielder cuts it off. Two taken.

FOUR! Nicely played! That should release some of the pressure. That brings up the 100 for South Africa. Short and outside off. De Kock stays inside the line of the ball simply helps it to third man. One bounce and over the ropes.
Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen gets the inside edge past square leg for one.
A short one, on the body. Rassie van der Dussen ducks under it and it is called a wide.
On a length, outside off. De Kock runs it down to third man for one.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.

Close again! Jayant Yadav bowls it flatter, on off and gets some sharp turn on it. Rassie van der Dussen is beaten as he looks to block and gets hit on the pads. The appeal is turned down again. Might be turning a bit too much there.
A single as this is pushed past cover.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.

Review not taken! Height would have been an issue there! Tossed up, on middle. De Kock looks to slog sweep it away but misses. He is hit on the pads and there is a big appeal. The umpire turns it down and India decide not to review it. Yup. Ball Tracker shows it would have gone over the stumps. But Jayant Yadav is creating a few issues for the batters here.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Loopy ball, on middle. De Kock looks to work it away but gets the leading edge to covers.

Fifty for Quinton de Kock! He has looked in superb touch and the others need to bat around him now. De Kock would want to convert this to a big ton. Shorter, outside off. Cut away to deep cover for one.
A nice bumper, on the body. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it towards fine leg for one.
Full, around off. Pushed past point for a single. Actually, there was a loud 'NO' by Rassie van der Dussen at first. But once it went past point, there was always a run.
Play and a miss! A nice bumper by Bumrah, outside off. De Kock looks to ramp it to third man but misses.
Full this time, on off. De Kock pushes it to cover.
On a length, around off. Blocked out by Quinton de Kock.
Jasprit Bumrah (4-0-21-0) is back into the attack.
Darted on the pads. De Kock works it past square leg for one.
Nicely flighted, around off. De Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
Full, on off. Blocked out,

Misfield again! Quinton de Kock comes down the track so Yadav tosses it up and drags his length back a bit. De Kock looks to flick it away but gets the leading edge towards point. Krishna there fumbles and they get two.
Fuller, on off. Pushed past covers for one.

Dropped! That was a tough one though! Tossed up, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge. Pant doesn't catch it as the ball hits his fingertips and drops down. That carried very fast to him but should have been taken at this level.
On a length, on off. Blocked out with ease.
Well bowled! A sharp bumper, right on the body. De Kock goes for the pull but misses it. Really well bowled.
This time Rassie van der Dussen cuts it well after hopping up. It goes to third man for one.
Almost chopped on! Shorter and outside off. Ravichandran Ashwin hops up to cut it but gets the bottom edge. It goes just past the stumps and back to the keeper.
Short of a length, outside off. Nicely punched through covers for another couple.
FOUR! Oh, that is glorious! A bit too full and outside off by Prasidh Krishna. Rassie van der Dussen lunges forward and punches it past mid off for a boundary.
Darted shorter, around off. Rassie van der Dussen lets the ball turn back in and pushes it to deep cover for one.
Fuller, on off. Pushed through covers for a single by de Kock.
Loopy ball, around off. De Kock looks to block but gets the inside edge on the pads.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out from the crease.
Well bowled! Full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen doesn't get under it and heaves it to long on for one,
Nicely tossed up, on off. De Kock pushes it past cover for one. Oh, well that is a no ball as Jayant Yadav has overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
Flatter, on off. Worked past square leg for one.
Spin for the first time today as Jayant Yadav comes on to bowl.
On a length, on off. Blocked out. Just 1 from that over. The Indians are bowling really well now.
Short and wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen goes for the cut gets the outside edge to third man for one.
Yet another dot as Rassie van der Dussen blocks out this length ball.
Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen hops up and blocks it.
A bumper, on middle and leg. Left alone.
On a length, around off. Pushed to cover.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep square leg for one. He is off the mark.
On a length, on off. Blocked out by Rassie van der Dussen.
Full and outside off. Left alone.
Length, on middle and leg. Worked past square leg for one.

DRINKS! South Africa lose their third wicket and the umpires call for a Drinks break. The visitors have been on top here and Deepak Chahar, who does well in Powerplay 1, has done so yet again. Giving him a long spell has worked and the hosts are in a spot of bother. Their middle order hasn't quite been tested yet in this series and today might be the chance for the likes of Miller to step up. Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! The plan works for India! Chahar bowls a short one, on the body. Markram goes for the pull and doesn't middle it well. He hits it straight towards deep mid-wicket. The substitute fielder, Ruturaj Gaikwad, takes a few steps towards the ball and gathers it!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Ruturaj Gaikwad b Deepak Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: Tap and run. Length ball, on off. De Kock plays it with soft hands to the off side and they steal a quick single.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Short of a length, around off. Markram goes for the punch but gets the inside edge. It runs to the fine leg fence though.
A bit too full, on off. Pushed to mid on for one.
Beaten! Really well bowled. Length ball, lands on middle and angles away. De Kock looks to block it from the crease but it zips past the outside edge.
Short of a length, around off. De Kock looks to work it away but gets the leading edge. It drops well short of point though.
Short of a length, around off. Chopped past the diving point fielder for one.
Lands safe! A bumper, nicely directed at the body. De Kock goes for the pull but gets the top edge. The ball drops near the vacant mid-wicket region and they get one.
Back of a length, around off and shaping away a bit. Markram works it towards cover.
WIDE! Chahar tries to bowl full and attack the pads but spills it down the leg side. Wide called.
On a good length, around the hips. De Kock tucks it away through square leg for a run.
WIDE! An attempted slower bumper from Chahar. This one goes well over the head of de Kock yet again. Wided.
On off, this is pushed towards the cover region.
FOUR! Geez, that's a good shot! By no means a half volley and Quinton de Kock just punches it back past the bowler and beats mid off for another boundary.
On middle and leg, flicked away to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Too high! Chahar goes for a steep bumper but the ball loops over the head of de Kock. Wided.
Full and wide, this is slashed through covers for a single.
Powerplay 2 has begun now. 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over now.
A length, on the pads. De Kock works it behind square on the leg side for a couple. South Africa are 53/2 at the end of Powerplay 1.
A good-length ball, on off. De Kock defends it out.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! On off, Quinton de Kock drives on the up and times it to perfection. The straight drive goes past the bowler and no one is stopping that one.
Back of a length, angled across the off stump. De Kock hops back and gets an inside edge back onto the deck. That one could have gone anywhere.
Brilliant shot for no run. Full and wide, de Kock creams the cover drive but straight to Suryakumar Yadav, who is sharp in the field.
Krishna starts off with a very full delivery, around off. De Kock jams it out to mid off.
Prasidh Krishna is brought on now. He replaces Jasprit Bumrah.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Just a little shimmy down the track from Aiden Markram and he drives the overpitched ball beautifully back past the bowler for a boundary.
Chahar drifts onto the pads and Markram just nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Full and wide, this is driven on the up towards extra cover.
Around the top of off. Markram defends it right under his eyes.

Fuller one, on the pads and this is clipped away towards deep backward square leg for a single. Quinton de Kock doesn't seem pleased with himself and feels he could have easily put that one away for a boundary.
Width on offer again and this is just caressed straight to cover-point by de Kock.
Bumrah hits the length hard and bowls it on off. Markram hangs back and dabs it down towards short mid on.
A good-length ball, around off. Markram defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! Full and angling in on middle. Aiden Markram flicks it away off the inner half of the bat and the ball just races away to the square leg fence. He wanted to go straighter but got a thick inside edge it ran away to the fence.
Bumrah angles a length ball, at the body from 'round the wicket. De Kock tucks it away leg side for a single.
Bumrah tries to attack the pads but Markram manages to flick it away to fine leg for one.
Back of a length, around off. Markram gets right behind the line of the ball to block.

Misfield and Rahul might have hurt himself a bit. Full again, at a gentle pace and de Kock punches it firmly towards mid off. KL Rahul completely misses the ball and it goes through his hands but he chases back and pulls it inside. Two taken. Rahul too seems fine.
Shorter in length and there is a bit of width on offer. Quinton de Kock though can't get it through cover-point.
Pitched up, around middle and leg. De Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
Aiden Markram is the next batter.

OUT! RUN OUT! Well, well! Temba Bavuma didn't look one bit concerned about that one but he is a goner. Fuller in length, around off and this is just pushed towards mid off for a quick single. Bavuma is quick to get out of the blocks but doesn't quite run in a straight line after crossing the bowler and instead angles away to his left. KL Rahul attacks the ball well and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The third umpire has a look and just that split second of changing direction has cost Bavuma dearly as he is just short of the crease.
Is that a run out? Virat Kohli at extra cover looks very confident. Yup, looks like Temba Bavuma is just short! A big wicket for India.
Nicely bowled! This is angled in from outside off but shapes away nicely after pitching. Bavuma makes an easy leave.
Full and straight, driven nicely but straight to mid on.
Early call for two and they get it with ease. On a length, around the pads and this is flicked past square leg for a couple.
This is a low full toss, on off. Quinton de Kock misses out on that one as he drives it without much timing back towards the bowler.
A touch fuller, angled across on middle. De Kock punches it gently towards mid on.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off.
Uppish but safe! Short and wide, angling away. Bavuma cuts it through backward point. The ball goes on the bounce towards third man and they get a single.
A length ball, angled in on off. Bavuma stands tall and taps it towards cover.
Chahar goes full again, just outside off. This is punched to covers.
Full, on off. Worked past mid-wicket for a couple.

Nicely punched by Quinton de Kock! He punches this wide length ball, through covers. KL Rahul chases it and slides to stop it. He throws it to Kohli and the former skipper throws it back in. Two taken.
Too full this time by Chahar, on off. Pushed wide of mid off for one.
Well bowled. Length ball, landing just outside off and shaping away. Temba Bavuma leaves it with ease.
Too full and on middle. Worked past mid-wicket for one.
On a length, on off. Pushed to cover by Bavuma.
Bumrah goes shorter this time, on off. Blocked out by Bavuma with ease.
Length ball, angling across off. Worked to third man by de Kock for one.
On a length, around off. De Kock blocks it from the crease.
Back of a length, around off. Bavuma rises and works it towards third man for one.
FOUR! Punished by Bavuma this time! On the pads and too full. This is flicked past mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Punished again! Full again and too wide outside off. De Kock carves it past covers for a boundary.

Fuller, outside off. De Kock drives it aerially but through covers. Rahul chases it and he loses his balance a bit while he looks to gather it. But he pops the ball inside the ropes, goes over, comes back and throws it. Two taken.

There is some issue with the ball. The last boundary might have done a bit of damage and the umpires are having a look at it. The ball doesn't quite fit through one of the gauges and they decide to change it.
Fuller, on off. Pushed to mid off. Better from Chahar.
FOUR! Nope, even if you have just taken a wicket, you cannot bowl there to Quinton de Kock! Full and on the pads. Quinton de Kock nicely flicks it past mid on and gets a boundary.
Full and wide outside off. Driven past point for one. Bavuma is off the mark.
The skipper, Temba Bavuma, is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Gone this time! Brilliant bowling by Chahar here. He serves a length ball, right in the corridor of uncertainty. Malan once again looks to block it with his feet going nowhere. He loses his balance a bit and moves forward. The ball nicely shapes away and takes the outside edge. Rishabh Pant takes it with ease this time. Great start for India!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Deepak Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Oh, nicely done! Jasprit Bumrah bowls a length ball, but on the pads. De Kock flicks it past square leg and the ball runs to the fence. First boundary of the game.
Jasprit Bumrah serves a full ball, this lands on off and comes back in. Malan nicely works it towards mid on though.
Too full and a bit too wide. Left alone.
Inside edge on the pads! This lands outside off, on a length and tails back in. Malan looks to block it from the crease but gets a big inside edge back on the pads.
On a length, around off. De Kock looks to work it away but gets the outside edge towards third man for one.
Fuller, around off. De Kock presses forward and pushes it to mid off. Good start for Jasprit Bumrah.
Jasprit Bumrah to take the other new ball.
Full and outside off. Left alone.

Just short of first slip! That is a peach of a delivery by Deepak Chahar! Length ball, just outside off. Malan looks to block from the crease but the ball shapes away to take the outside edge. Dhawan gets low to his right at first slip but it drops just short of him.
Quinton de Kock gets off the mark. Fuller, on off. He looks to work it away but gets the leading edge towards cover for one.
Fuller again, around off. Pushed towards mid on now.
Better. Length ball, just outside off. It shapes in a bit but de Kock leaves it well.
Nice and full, outside off. A bit of away shape on that and de Kock drives it. The man at mid off though dives to his left and stops it.
WIDE! Chahar starts off with a gentle loosener, way outside off. Left alone and a wide is signaled. South Africa are up and running with that.

Done with the national anthems and it's time to play! South African openers, Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock take guard as the Indian players spread out on the field. The players from South Africa are seen taking the knee to show their support for the BLM movement. Deepak Chahar has the new ball in hand and is raring to go...

We are minutes away from play! The two teams are in the middle and are ready for their respective National Anthems. It's going to be the national anthem of India first, followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

PITCH REPORT - Dale Steyn says that there are a few sticky patches just like KL Rahul mentioned and with two new balls, the Indian pacers will look to get early breakthroughs. He adds that it is very hot in Cape Town today and it will get easy for the batters if they are able to fend off the new ball.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that Dwaine Pretorius is in for Tabraiz Shamsi. Adds that it is very important that they don't drop their intensity and keep pushing their standard higher and higher. Says that the change in venue is a different challenge as batting in the first few overs might be difficult. Confesses that he doesn't really know what a winning total might look like here but anything over 300 should be good.

KL Rahul, the Indian skipper, says they will have a bowl first because the wicket feels a bit sticky and they will try and get a few early wickets. He adds that they value each result and work hard as a team to win every match and the boys do work really hard which makes things easy as a captain. He also mentions that they will look to make use of the ball early on and win it with the bat later on. Adds that there are a few things that they need to fix and a few things to get better at as individuals. Informs that there are four changes to the team today.

India (Playing XI) - KL Rahul (C), Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli, Rishabh Pant (WK), Shreyas Iyer, Suryakumar Yadav (In for Venkatesh Iyer), Jayant Yadav (In for Ravichandran Ashwin), Deepak Chahar (In for Shardul Thakur), Jasprit Bumrah, Yuzvendra Chahal, Prasidh Krishna (In for Bhuvneshwar Kumar).

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Dwaine Pretorius (In for Tabraiz Shamsi), Keshav Maharaj, Sisanda Magala, Lungi Ngidi.
Toss - Both the skippers are out in the middle and Temba Bavuma flips the coin. It lands in favour of India and they will BOWL first!

Well, not a lot of people expected the hosts to be so dominant against a side of India's stature, in spite of how depleted the visitors might be, but boy, the Proteas have been brilliant. They have managed to keep the Indian batters at bay in both the games and with the bat, they have just been excellent. The top order might have failed in the first match but both, Malan and de Kock were just sensational in the second match. And just like the first match, their middle order played sensibly and saw their team through in what was a comfortable win. There might be changes in both camps today but the hosts will sure look to get another win under their belt to inflict a clean sweep. But expect India to play without pressure and that might help them quite a bit. So, will South Africa be able to make it 3-0? Or will India end the tour with a consolation win? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

The second ODI panned out pretty much the same way as the first ODI and the visitors were found wanting yet again. India have not been able to control the match on the whole and they need more passages of positive play. The batting has been patchy and even though, a couple of players have managed to play well, the lack of big partnerships up the order has hurt them. Thakur has certainly been a positive down the order and Pant has shown his worth as well. The bowling though has been an even bigger letdown and they haven't been able to control the middle overs at all. They need a big performance with the ball today if they are to win this match.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final ODI of the three-match series between South Africa and India at the Newlands in Cape Town. The hosts have already wrapped up the series and will be looking for a clean sweep here. India, on the other hand, will be looking to end a disappointing series with a win. This might be a dead rubber but when you are playing for your country, there is always plenty at stake.
